caption: The drawing depicts a square, tapestry-like composition bordered by a gray fringe. In the center, there are two yellow and light pink cats facing each other, positioned above a yellow square box-like object with a cross-stitched circular pattern on its front. Above the cats are pink and red hearts and a collection of various flowers, including a prominent red flower, clusters of blue flowers, and white blooms. Two blue ribbon-like elements extend outward from the flower arrangement. The background consists of green foliage interspersed with red, white, and purple flowers. Below the cats and box, smaller items such as flowers, a red ball, and a brown diagonal pole or stick are present on a green ground with a checkered pattern. The overall color palette includes shades of yellow, pink, green, red, blue, and gray, giving the sewn pattern a colorful appearance.
title: Sampler
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
